jobDescription:

AI Platform Engineering

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid - in office at least 3 days/week)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and visionary technology leader to lead the development and scaling of our Operational AI platform capabilities. This role will own the strategy, architecture, delivery, and operational excellence of Couchbase AI Cloud Platform capabilities. This is a strategic leadership role at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and AI. You will lead a large, multi-layered engineering organization responsible for delivering The Operational Data Platform for AI, while partnering closely with Product, Design, SRE, and Go-To-Market teams. Your leadership will directly influence company growth, customer adoption, platform reliability, and Couchbase’s competitive position in the market. This role requires a balance of strategic vision, organizational leadership, and technical depth.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and grow high-performing engineering teams focused on building the Operational Data platform for AI.
• Drive architectural decisions for multiple platform capabilities at the intersection of Databases, Paa S and AI.
• Ensure production-grade scalability for large-scale workloads.
• Partner closely with Product, Field, Support, and Customer Success to deliver differentiated enterprise AI capabilities.
• Balance innovation with operational rigour and ensuring reliability, performance, and security standards are met.
• Build strong cross-functional collaboration with core database, storage, and cloud infrastructure teams.
• Partner Cross-Functionally at the Executive Level
• Manage Risk, Investment, and Efficiency
• Mentor engineering managers and senior technical leaders to build a strong leadership team.
• Drive Execution Excellence at Scale by establishing metrics and KPIs for engineering performance, reliability, and productivity.

Required Qualifications
  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with 5+ years leading multiple teams.
  • Strong background in distributed systems, databases, or large-scale cloud platforms.
  • Deep Experience in Cloud Platforms - AWS, GCP, Azure
  • Hands-on familiarity with Data and AI infrastructure concepts such as:
  • Vector search and indexing
  • Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Embedding pipelines
  • LLM and inference systems
  • Agent architectures and memory systems
  • Experience building and operating production Saa S services at scale.
  • Deep understanding of performance engineering, reliability, and cost optimization in cloud environments.
  • Experience in Go, Python or Java.

Lead Software Engineer - Storage

As a key contributing member of the storage development team, you will be responsible for enhancing the highly scalable and performant storage engines used by both Couchbase Server and Couchbase Capella. Most of all, you will be able to celebrate the wins by experiencing the direct result of your hard work from our customers’ success stories. Nitro: A Fast, Scalable In-Memory Storage Engine for No SQL Global Secondary Index

Magma: A High Data Density Storage Engine Used in Couchbase

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of experience building enterprise-grade infrastructure or systems software.
  • Proficient in C++, Golang or Java.
  • Experience with designing and writing concurrent/multi-threaded programs.
  • Deep knowledge of advanced operating system concepts and data structures.
  • Knowledge of LSM trees is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Linux I/O stack and Database internals.
  • Experience with performance analysis and debugging.
  • Experience in Distributed Systems is a plus.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus
  • You’re a self-motivated, independent, and high-performance individual.
  • You learn quickly and you enjoy worthy challenges.
  • You’re a good communicator and an excellent team player.
  • You like working in organizations that strive to have a good balance between doing it right and moving quickly.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and develop features to enhance high performance, highly reliable storage engines for Couchbase Server and Couchbase Capella.
  • Proactively take ownership in the product, and provide excellent technical ambition in finding solutions to propel the product forward.
  • Discuss and debate with your peers as you help figure out product requirements and the architectural approach to getting things built, tested & supported.
  • Produce enterprise-level quality software and solutions that are performant for a highly-available system.
  • Exhibit unrelenting motivation to investigate and find causes for customer-facing issues, and to derive optimal solutions in software improvements.

The Key-Value Engine is the component at the center of the Couchbase universe. It is responsible for storing and managing data, delivering low latency ops at high scale, supporting intra and cross-cluster replication for high availability and replicating documents to downstream clients.

You’ll be part of a team of high caliber individuals focused on improving performance and scale as you help us push back boundaries: such as a more flexible and powerful protocol, higher-performance caching, richer data structures, more scalable infrastructure and distributed transactions. You’ll work in C++ (and sometimes C), and from time-to-time read Golang, Erlang, and Python. You’ll work on problems that build on your knowledge of concurrency, networking and your software engineering skills to extract maximum performance from the hardware and kernel.

  • With your team, you’ll help build the world’s fastest, most scalable, richly-functional key-value engine.
